01 / RECORD

Show us your prosthesis.

Record a slow, steady video around your prosthesis in good light. Include a 200 mm scale target. Capture front, back, both sides, then tilt above for a clear top-opening view and show the bolt side up close.

Attach the scale before recording

Download the 200 mm ruler, print on A4 at 100% actual size (do not fit to page), and check the 0–200 mm distance with a physical ruler. Cut out the strip and fix it flat beside the prosthesis without moving it during recording. Keep both endpoints visible in several clear views; do not wrap or bend the ruler around the socket.

Download 200 mm ruler (A4 PDF) ↓Print and verify the ruler before recording your video.
Recording tipMove slowly around the prosthesis and keep it centered in the frame.
